EventsById.name: EventsById
EventsById.description: Gets event data by a list of event IDs and optional calendar ID to filter.

eventIds.description: Comma separated list of event IDs (e.g. '536,525,506,535'). When at least one ID doesn't exist the whole query return a 404 error.

calendarId.description: Calendar to filter the events by.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches Webling calendar events by their IDs, optionally narrowing the result to a single calendar. Use it when you already have event IDs and need their full details. Pass IDs as a comma-separated string (e.g. "536,525,506"); if any ID does not exist the entire request fails with a 404. Read-only and idempotent.

onEventChanged.name: onEventChanged
onEventChanged.description: Triggers when an event is added or updated.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a calendar event in Webling is created or updated since the last poll, optionally scoped to a specific calendar. Represents a new or modified event you may want to act on.

onChangedData.name: onChangedData
onChangedData.description: Triggers when anything was added, updated or deleted since last request.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when any Webling data changes since the last poll, covering creations, updates, and deletions across all object types (members, accounts, calendar events, documents, and more). Represents a batch of changed and deleted record IDs since the previous request, not a single record event.

nl.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: Haalt gegevens van afspraken op met een lijst van event IDs en optionele kalender ID om te filteren.
Kommagescheiden lijst met event IDs (bijv. '536,525,506,535'). Wanneer ten minste één ID niet bestaat geeft de hele query een 404 fout.
Kalender om gebeurtenissen op te filteren.
nl.Triggers when an event is added or updat: Triggert wanneer een gebeurtenis wordt toegevoegd of bijgewerkt.
nl.Triggers when anything was added, update: Triggers wanneer er iets is toegevoegd, bijgewerkt of verwijderd sinds de laatste aanvraag.

de.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: Ruft Ereignisdaten durch eine Liste von Ereignis-IDs und optionale Kalender-ID zum Filtern ab.
Durch Komma getrennte Liste von Ereignis-IDs (z.B. '536,525,506,535'). Wenn mindestens eine ID nicht existiert, gibt die ganze Abfrage einen 404-Fehler zurück.
de.Triggers when an event is added or updat: Wird ausgelöst, wenn ein Ereignis hinzugefügt oder aktualisiert wird.
de.Triggers when anything was added, update: Wird ausgelöst, wenn seit der letzten Anfrage etwas hinzugefügt, aktualisiert oder gelöscht wurde.

fr.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: Récupère les données d'événement par une liste d'ID d'événements et l'ID de calendrier facultatif à filtrer.
Liste des ID d'événements séparés par des virgules (par exemple '536,525,506,535'). Quand au moins un ID n'existe pas, la requête entière renvoie une erreur 404.
fr.New or Updated Event: Nouvel événement ou mise à jour
fr.Triggers when an event is added or updat: Se déclenche lorsqu'un événement est ajouté ou mis à jour.
fr.Triggers when anything was added, update: Déclenche quand quelque chose a été ajouté, mis à jour ou supprimé depuis la dernière requête.

es.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: Obtiene los datos del evento por una lista de IDs de eventos y el ID de calendario opcional para filtrar.
Lista separada por comas de IDs de eventos (por ejemplo, '536,525,506,535'). Cuando al menos un ID no existe la consulta completa devuelve un error 404.
es.Triggers when an event is added or updat: Dispara cuando se agrega o actualiza un evento.
es.Triggers when anything was added, update: Dispara cuando algo fue añadido, actualizado o eliminado desde la última petición.

ja.Get Events by ID: イベントを ID で取得する
ja.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: イベント ID と任意のカレンダー ID のリストからフィルターを取得します。
イベントIDのカンマ区切りのリスト（例：'536,525,506,535'）。少なくとも1つのIDが存在しない場合、クエリ全体が404エラーを返します。
イベントをフィルタリングするカレンダーです。
ja.New or Updated Event: 新規または更新されたイベント
ja.Triggers when an event is added or updat: イベントが追加または更新されたときにトリガーします.
ja.Triggers when anything was added, update: 前回のリクエストから何かが追加されたとき、更新または削除されたときにトリガーします。

zh.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: Gets event data by a list of event IDs and optional calendar ID to filter.
Comma separated list of event IDs (e.g. '536,525,506,535'). When at least one ID doesn't exist the whole query return a 404 error.
Calendar to filter the events by.
zh.Triggers when an event is added or updat: Triggers when an event is added or updated.
zh.Triggers when anything was added, update: Triggers when anything was added, updated or deleted since last request.

pt.Gets event data by a list of event IDs a: Obtém dados de evento por uma lista de IDs de evento e ID de calendário opcional para filtrar.
Lista separada por vírgulas de IDs de eventos (por exemplo, '536,525,506,535'). Quando pelo menos um ID não existe, toda a consulta retorna um erro 404.
pt.Triggers when an event is added or updat: Dispara quando um evento é adicionado ou atualizado.
pt.Triggers when anything was added, update: Dispara quando qualquer coisa foi adicionada, atualizada ou excluída desde a última solicitação.
